visual.name: plumeSunburst
visual.description: Sunburst chart with the Plume Studio look: 1 to 8 hierarchy levels as rings, two modes (click a sector to open the level beneath with an animated zoom, breadcrumb and back, or every level always shown), labels that follow the arcs, center total, percent of parent and of total, Others grouping, cross-filtering and highlighting; premium play axis, icicle and half sunburst views, one color per level, ring thickness options, grouping below a share of the parent, comparison band with a previous period, color by variance to target or by a measure, branch highlight and summary rings for hidden levels.
